description: Defines the SharedImageVideoProvider class for managing shared images in GPU media processing, including image specifications, callbacks, and external dependencies.

classes.name: SharedImageVideoProvider
classes.description: Abstract class for providing shared images in GPU media processing, with methods for initialization and requesting images.

classes.name: SharedImageVideoProvider::ImageSpec
classes.description: Struct describing properties of a shared image, including size, color space, and generation ID.

classes.name: SharedImageVideoProvider::ImageRecord
classes.description: Struct representing a shared image record, including mailbox, release callback, codec image holder, and Vulkan context flag.

methods.name: SharedImageVideoProvider::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provider, executing a callback with the shared context state.

methods.name: SharedImageVideoProvider::RequestImage
methods.description: Requests a shared image matching specified properties, executing a callback when available.
